title: GuidedSDG: Agentic Workflow for Synthetic Tabular Data Generation and Evaluation
description: GuidedSDG is a Large Language Model (LLM) assisted workflow for synthetic tabular data generation and evaluation. It guides users through data preparation, generator selection, synthetic data generation, and evaluation, and incorporates human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions that let users review and revise agent recommendations throughout the workflow.
